project.title: Community succession  analysis for phenolic pollution treatment
project.description: We discovered an engineering microbiome construction process: in a series of domestication, small pilot, pilot and engineering application, a group of powerful and stable microbial community was developed, which is suitable for the treatment of high concentration phenol and formaldehyde wastewater. In this paper, the assemble and evolve process of the community are analyzed to reveal how the stable-efficient community developed during the self-assembly progress, which could provide forceful reference for the development of functional microflora applied in engineering.
project.center_name: Tianjin Institute of Industrial Biotechnology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
